name: RACI Student Membership
summary: Discounted Royal Australian Chemical Institute membership for chemistry students, with a separate PhD rate.
key: $28.00 inc. GST annually (undergraduate, Honours and Masters); $64.00 for PhD students.
who: Certificate, Diploma, Undergraduate, Honours and Masters students in chemistry-related courses
PhD students use the Postgraduate Student (MRACI) category
how: Choose a membership type, select Join now and upload formal confirmation of enrolment.
catches: Activation can take up to 24 hours.

evidence.quote: caters to Certificate, Diploma, Undergraduate, Honours, and Masters students in chemistry-related courses
